findings.issue: Unmarked se adds reflexive/middle force; the verb is qal imperfect 3fs, with no reflexive stem.
Common noun left untranslated as the Hebraized form tsaráat.
Cognate infinitive absolute plus finite verb is rendered as a gerund that can be read as manner rather than the same-root emphasis pair.

notes: The rest tracks the tokens: priest sees him on the seventh day, then the priest makes him unclean, plague plus 3fs pronoun.
